intent: Static-only wrapper around a shared mt19937_64 generator providing the repo's common random-number needs: raw 64-bit values, bounded ranges, random alphanumeric strings, and weighted booleans.

objects.name: SRandom
objects.role: all-static utility; rand64/limitedRand64 draw integers, randStr builds an alphanumeric string, randBool does a Bernoulli trial
